entries.axis_b: Exactly eleven tables

value.statement: tenant, app_user, department, membership, event, job, schedule, audit_event, action_invocation, idempotency_key and app_licence; no others

entries.axis_b: Transaction-local GUC only

value.statement: every store function takes TenantId as its first argument after the connection; begin_scoped sets app.current_tenant with set_config($1, $2, true); no session-level SET appears

entries.axis_b: The owner is included

value.statement: the nine tenant-owned tables are ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, each with one FOR ALL tenant_isolation policy carrying USING and WITH CHECK; membership adds one SELECT-only membership_self_read policy TO conveyor_runtime

entries.axis_b: Least privilege

value.statement: conveyor_migrate is the owner; conveyor_runtime is LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS; migrate asserts rolsuper = false and rolbypassrls = false and aborts otherwise; REVOKE ALL ON _sqlx_migrations FROM conveyor_runtime

entries.axis_b: An unlisted issuer is never fetched

value.statement: one realm conveyor; an unlisted iss is rejected before any JWKS fetch; per-issuer cache TTL 600 s with a 30 s negative floor; aud and azp are both required

entries.axis_b: Membership resolves the tenant

value.statement: CONVEYOR_DEV_AUTH=1 accepts Bearer dev:<login> or the conveyor_dev=<login> cookie; membership must resolve exactly one (app_user, tenant) or the request is a 401; migrate --dev-seed creates dev-a/alice and dev-b/bob; startup exits non-zero if set with APP_ENV=production

entries.axis_b: Fail closed

value.statement: RequireLicence reads app_licence only; absent, stale beyond 3600 s, expired, revoked or unknown refuses; a JWT-shaped token that fails verification is a hard 401, never retried as a licence token; licence.sync refreshes the row

entries.axis_b: A stale token writes nothing

value.statement: claim is FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with lease_token and lease_until; an expired lease is reclaimed and attempts increments; finish/retry are guarded by status = 'running' AND lease_token = $token; schedules materialise under pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('conveyor:schedule'))

entries.axis_b: Append-only

value.statement: audit_event grants SELECT and INSERT only; UPDATE and DELETE are revoked after the schema-wide GRANT; action matches ^[a-z0-9_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$; details are capped at 8192 bytes

entries.axis_b: Bounded replay

value.statement: Last-Event-ID is event.seq; replay is seq > $last AND topic = ANY($topics) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 500 in the subscriber's tenant scope; 15 s keepalive; a 64-slot channel closes a slow client with resync; the LISTEN connection is direct because PgBouncer is transaction-pooled

entries.axis_b: Unversioned /api

value.statement: GET /health, /health/live, /health/ready, /metrics, /api/me and /api/events; /api is one OpenApiRouter built with .routes(); --print-openapi emits the document and exits before config/DB

entries.axis_b: Same inside and outside; never 8000

value.statement: db on 5439 (postgres -p 5439), pgbouncer on 6439, app on 8930; integration tests start their own ephemeral container on a random host port; a container that cannot start fails, never skips

entries.axis_b: No transition leaves list.kind and archived_at contradictory

value.acceptance: proptest ≥256 cases: archived_at.is_some() implies from_kind == Archive; restore off a non-archive list is Err. crates/domain/src/board.rs::archived_implies_the_card_sits_in_an_archive_list and ::restore_off_a_non_archive_list_is_an_error.

entries.axis_b: A claim never succeeds twice without release or expiry

value.acceptance: crates/store/tests/claim_race.rs::thirty_two_racers_get_exactly_one_grant_and_the_fence_is_monotonic — exactly one Some, fence 1 then monotonic renewals, stale-fence completion writes nothing. Admitted limit (v1-s03-1): all 32 racers share seed.user and Version::INITIAL, so the version predicate decides the winner and the test would pass with the lease arm deleted.

entries.axis_b: One pending approval per (run, gate)

value.acceptance: approval_race.rs::sixteen_racers_create_exactly_one_pending_approval — one Ok, fifteen ApprovalConflict, pending count 1; uq_appr_pending is the guarantee.

entries.axis_b: Terminal-run and revision invariants

value.acceptance: transitions.rs::a_terminal_run_rejects_every_transition_and_a_revision_is_dense — a terminal run rejects every transition; revision seq is dense from 1; is_prunable('model') is true past 50 and false for 'requirement' at any depth.

entries.axis_b: All fourteen tables isolate runtime, owner and superuser

value.acceptance: rls_domain.rs::the_fourteen_domain_tables_isolate_runtime_owner_and_superuser — runtime scoped to A sees none of B's rows; a forged tenant_id=B insert fails WITH CHECK; owner 0; superuser both.

entries.axis_b: Two migrations, one embedded set, no IF NOT EXISTS

value.acceptance: fresh database applies 2; the second `cargo run -p conveyor-server -- migrate` exits 0 with _sqlx_migrations unchanged; store/src/migrate.rs asserts [(1,"platform"),(2,"domain")]; no `IF NOT EXISTS` in the file.

entries.axis_b: A card has no state or status column

value.acceptance: information_schema.columns for card and column_name in ('state','status') returns zero rows; an insta snapshot pins Card's field set; the plan's word-boundary grep returns 0.

entries.axis_b: Fourteen FORCE policies, no exception

value.acceptance: `grep -c 'FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY' migrations/0002_domain.sql` returns 14; every policy is FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = app_current_tenant()) WITH CHECK (the same).

entries.axis_b: Eleven kinds and one delivery matrix row

value.acceptance: catalogue_entry.kind has no CHECK by design; S03 fixes the eleven labels (project_type, phase, recipe, wip_limit, gate, capability, deliverable_kind, milestone_kind, priority_level, board_template, architecture_standard); the delivery matrix is one project_type row with code='delivery' and meta.matrix (S3-D1).

entries.axis_b: A second reader checks 14 tables against §2.3/§2.4

value.acceptance: a line-by-line review yielding 14 tables with zero deviations or a reviewed list. No contemporaneous review record exists; this retrospective review re-performs the check and admits v1-s03-2 (the archive-exclusion claim covers only the two board-scan indexes).

entries.axis_b: A move keeps the boards in agreement and refuses a stale version

value.acceptance: transitions.rs::a_move_keeps_the_boards_in_agreement_and_refuses_a_stale_version — card.board_id equals list.board_id in the same statement; a move from a stale version is refused (plan trap 8).

entries.axis_b: One record per fact

value.acceptance: No concept is stored in two systems; systems join by pinned reference (P1, §10.1).

entries.axis_b: No work without a card

value.acceptance: No work without a card; no transition without an action; no completion without evidence (P3).

entries.axis_b: The executor never approves its own work

value.acceptance: Dual control on gates; `decided_by_kind`; the approver is neither the assignee nor the executor (P4).

entries.axis_b: Fail closed on missing configuration

value.acceptance: An unresolved binding, pack, prompt source or tool refuses `409 *_not_ready` with `blocking[]` before the first model call or action (P8).

entries.axis_b: Every model call is ledgered and budgeted

value.acceptance: `inference_call` rows with per-run and per-tenant budgets (P9).

entries.axis_b: No speculative aggregates

value.acceptance: A table exists because a named procedure uses it and a metric reads it; an unused aggregate is removed, not defended (P10, D40).

entries.axis_b: Tenant configuration over code

value.acceptance: Every policy, threshold, limit, gate condition and approval kind is a versioned tenant-scoped row with a platform default; code implements mechanisms, never policy values (P11, D50).

entries.axis_b: Immutable releases; a stale binding refuses

value.acceptance: A binding pins `job_key` + `release_hash` + an immutable `release_snapshot`; a run against a retired binding refuses `409 job_binding_stale` before any model call (D38).

entries.axis_b: Tool effects are typed

value.acceptance: Every tool declares one of read | write | destructive | spend; a binding's ceiling narrows only; destructive needs a dry-run and the tenant's configured approvals (D45, §11.4).

entries.axis_b: A benefit is measurable

value.acceptance: A benefit without baseline, target, method and owner is refused; the benefits map names output → capability → operational outcome → benefit → objective (D62, §8.3).

entries.axis_b: A delivery project needs its governing contract

value.acceptance: A delivery project cannot pass design without the live contract that governs it; a Phase-G review records exactly one of the six standard levels (D63, §8.1).

entries.axis_b: The agent platform is a front end

value.acceptance: It is a conversation surface over MCP with its own autonomy configuration — not a catalogue, an executor or a system of record for conveyor work (D33, D59).

entries.axis_b: laya answers inside the seam budget

value.acceptance: `POST /v1/systemone`, 1500 ms default / 3 s hard budget, fail policy per decision policy; a timeout never becomes an LLM decision (§10.2, §7).

entries.axis_b: V1 is amended, not replaced

value.acceptance: V1 D1–D27 stand except D14 and D22, which V2 amends (D46, D61); no V1 S-slice is re-opened.

entries.axis_b: Procedural knowledge has no ontology store

value.acceptance: Amended 2026-11-19: RDF/OWL/Turtle is imported as a strata knowledge pack named by the procedure's `knowledge_pack_ref`; the conveyor runs no RDF store, no graph store and no reasoner (D53, §5.6).

entries.axis_b: One organisation spine

value.acceptance: industry and the extended department (industry_id, ordinal, is_primary) exist with FORCE RLS; one primary department per industry. crates/store/tests/organisation.rs::organisation_tables_are_forced_rls and ::job_departments_are_ordered_and_placement_is_validated.

entries.axis_b: A job, a release and a binding

value.acceptance: A job is created, job_releases.publish writes one release with a 64-hex release_hash over the canonical snapshot, and job_bindings.create pins it. crates/store/tests/organisation.rs::release_hash_is_deterministic_and_publish_is_idempotent.

entries.axis_b: A stale pin is refused

value.acceptance: A run naming a retired binding, or a release other than the binding's pin, is 409 job_binding_stale naming both hashes before any model call. crates/store/tests/organisation.rs::a_run_pins_its_binding_and_a_retired_or_mismatched_pin_is_refused; the action surface in crates/actions/tests/sop_ingestion.rs::a_bound_job_runs_the_pddl_steps.

entries.axis_b: No concept has two stores

value.acceptance: The SPEC_V2 §10.1 ownership matrix assigns each fact one system of record; job_catalogue, job_release and job_binding join the conveyor's own rows; there is no imported manifest and no live copy of another system's data.

entries.axis_b: An extensible executor kind

value.acceptance: executor_kind is an open slug (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$) stored as TEXT with no value CHECK; a test-only third kind registers and resolves without editing the run path. crates/domain/src/executor.rs; crates/store/tests/organisation.rs::third_executor_kind_registers_without_editing_the_run_path.

entries.axis_b: Decision-ladder types, no evaluation

value.acceptance: The five decision tables exist with FORCE RLS and no evaluation path is added (T2). migrations/0040_organisation.sql; crates/actions/tests/decision_ladder.rs exercises the audit shape T2 will use.

entries.axis_b: One action contract

value.acceptance: Every organisation action is one ActionSpec served over HTTP, MCP and OpenAPI and pinned in served-spec.lock.json: industries.create|get|list, departments.create|list, job_catalogue.create|update|retire|get|list, job_releases.publish|retire|list, job_bindings.create|retire|get|list.

entries.axis_b: A tenant refinement changes a threshold with no code change

value.acceptance: `decision_ladder.rs::a_refinement_changes_a_threshold_without_a_code_change` publishes a 0.5 override on a 0.8 policy and the same 0.7 answer moves from `refused` to `accepted`, pinning refinement version 1 and policy version 1.

entries.axis_b: Every decision pins the policy, refinement and laya-config versions it read

entries.axis_b: A generated draft cannot transition a card on the apply or update path

value.acceptance: `decision_ladder.rs::a_generated_draft_cannot_transition_a_card` refuses a refused L1 decision and an accepted L1 decision with 422 `draft_requires_gate`; the human `draft.apply` decision backed by an approved gate on the card applies the draft; `documents.update` attaching the generated class is 409 `draft_requires_gate`; `ladder_human_gate.rs::only_a_human_draft_apply_decision_can_gate_a_draft` bars a routine accepted decision.

entries.axis_b: A generated draft cannot be attached by `documents.compose`

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-1: `documents.compose` accepts `card_id` and `meta.generated = true` and creates an attached document with no `draft.apply` check. This is the P0 finding that blocks the fourth clause and the project's closure.

entries.axis_b: A human decision cites the approval of its own gate

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-6: `ladder.record` passes `None` for the gate to `human_approved_gate_tx`, so any approved approval with a human approve decision on the same card qualifies. The check must compare `approval.gate` with the decision's gate.

entries.axis_b: Options are authored, versioned rows

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-4: `ladder.evaluate` accepts an inline `options` array and records it with `option_set_version`; there is no authored option-set row the tenant versions independently of the request.

entries.axis_b: Questions are rows with fire_when, min_confidence and fail_policy

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-4: `decision_policy` carries kind, gate, threshold, fail_policy, action and meta; the question is an optional free string on the request, defaulted to the kind, and `fire_when`/`min_confidence` have no columns.

entries.axis_b: Publishing a refinement is a gated policy change

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-3: `refinements.publish` has `confirm = "none"`, writes the override and bumps the version with no approval; `decision_policies.update` is likewise ungated.

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-2: no T2 path calls `POST /v1/systemone`; the answer and confidence are supplied by the caller, and `laya_configs` only pins model_ref, params and timeout.

entries.axis_b: The owner is included

entries.axis_b: Least privilege

value.statement: conveyor_migrate is the owner; conveyor_runtime is LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS; migrate asserts rolsuper = false and rolbypassrls = false and aborts otherwise; REVOKE ALL ON _sqlx_migrations FROM conveyor_runtime

entries.axis_b: An unlisted issuer is never fetched

value.statement: one realm conveyor; an unlisted iss is rejected before any JWKS fetch; per-issuer cache TTL 600 s with a 30 s negative floor; aud and azp are both required

entries.axis_b: Membership resolves the tenant

value.statement: CONVEYOR_DEV_AUTH=1 accepts Bearer dev:<login> or the conveyor_dev=<login> cookie; membership must resolve exactly one (app_user, tenant) or the request is a 401; migrate --dev-seed creates dev-a/alice and dev-b/bob; startup exits non-zero if set with APP_ENV=production

entries.axis_b: Fail closed

value.statement: RequireLicence reads app_licence only; absent, stale beyond 3600 s, expired, revoked or unknown refuses; a JWT-shaped token that fails verification is a hard 401, never retried as a licence token; licence.sync refreshes the row

entries.axis_b: A stale token writes nothing

value.statement: claim is FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with lease_token and lease_until; an expired lease is reclaimed and attempts increments; finish/retry are guarded by status = 'running' AND lease_token = $token; schedules materialise under pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('conveyor:schedule'))

value.statement: db on 5439 (postgres -p 5439), pgbouncer on 6439, app on 8930; integration tests start their own ephemeral container on a random host port; a container that cannot start fails, never skips

entries.axis_b: One record per fact

value.acceptance: No concept is stored in two systems; systems join by pinned reference (P1, §10.1).

entries.axis_b: No work without a card

value.acceptance: No work without a card; no transition without an action; no completion without evidence (P3).

entries.axis_b: The executor never approves its own work

value.acceptance: Dual control on gates; `decided_by_kind`; the approver is neither the assignee nor the executor (P4).

entries.axis_b: Fail closed on missing configuration

value.acceptance: An unresolved binding, pack, prompt source or tool refuses `409 *_not_ready` with `blocking[]` before the first model call or action (P8).

entries.axis_b: Every model call is ledgered and budgeted

value.acceptance: `inference_call` rows with per-run and per-tenant budgets (P9).

entries.axis_b: No speculative aggregates

value.acceptance: A table exists because a named procedure uses it and a metric reads it; an unused aggregate is removed, not defended (P10, D40).

entries.axis_b: Tenant configuration over code

value.acceptance: Every policy, threshold, limit, gate condition and approval kind is a versioned tenant-scoped row with a platform default; code implements mechanisms, never policy values (P11, D50).

entries.axis_b: Immutable releases; a stale binding refuses

value.acceptance: A binding pins `job_key` + `release_hash` + an immutable `release_snapshot`; a run against a retired binding refuses `409 job_binding_stale` before any model call (D38).

entries.axis_b: Tool effects are typed

value.acceptance: Every tool declares one of read | write | destructive | spend; a binding's ceiling narrows only; destructive needs a dry-run and the tenant's configured approvals (D45, §11.4).

entries.axis_b: A benefit is measurable

value.acceptance: A benefit without baseline, target, method and owner is refused; the benefits map names output → capability → operational outcome → benefit → objective (D62, §8.3).

entries.axis_b: A delivery project needs its governing contract

value.acceptance: A delivery project cannot pass design without the live contract that governs it; a Phase-G review records exactly one of the six standard levels (D63, §8.1).

entries.axis_b: The agent platform is a front end

value.acceptance: It is a conversation surface over MCP with its own autonomy configuration — not a catalogue, an executor or a system of record for conveyor work (D33, D59).

entries.axis_b: laya answers inside the seam budget

value.acceptance: `POST /v1/systemone`, 1500 ms default / 3 s hard budget, fail policy per decision policy; a timeout never becomes an LLM decision (§10.2, §7).

entries.axis_b: V1 is amended, not replaced

value.acceptance: V1 D1–D27 stand except D14 and D22, which V2 amends (D46, D61); no V1 S-slice is re-opened.

entries.axis_b: Procedural knowledge has no ontology store

value.acceptance: Amended 2026-11-19: RDF/OWL/Turtle is imported as a strata knowledge pack named by the procedure's `knowledge_pack_ref`; the conveyor runs no RDF store, no graph store and no reasoner (D53, §5.6).

entries.axis_b: A rule, a laya and a human decision share one audit shape

value.acceptance: `decision_ladder.rs::a_rule_a_laya_and_a_human_decision_share_one_audit_shape` lists three rows with identical column sets and distinct rungs rule, laya and human; every row names `policy_id`, `policy_version`, `answer`, `confidence`, `actor_kind` and `latency_ms`.

entries.axis_b: A tenant refinement changes a threshold with no code change

value.acceptance: `decision_ladder.rs::a_refinement_changes_a_threshold_without_a_code_change` publishes a 0.5 override on a 0.8 policy and the same 0.7 answer moves from `refused` to `accepted`, pinning refinement version 1 and policy version 1.

entries.axis_b: Every decision pins the policy, refinement and laya-config versions it read

value.acceptance: `decision_ladder.rs::every_decision_pins_the_refinement_and_laya_config_versions`: an L1 decision with no laya config is `422 pins_incomplete`; with one, the row pins policy 1, refinement 1 and laya config 1; after the policy moves to 2, the stored first row still reads 1.

entries.axis_b: A generated draft cannot transition a card on the apply or update path

value.acceptance: `decision_ladder.rs::a_generated_draft_cannot_transition_a_card` refuses a refused L1 decision and an accepted L1 decision with 422 `draft_requires_gate`; the human `draft.apply` decision backed by an approved gate on the card applies the draft; `documents.update` attaching the generated class is 409 `draft_requires_gate`; `ladder_human_gate.rs::only_a_human_draft_apply_decision_can_gate_a_draft` bars a routine accepted decision.

entries.axis_b: A generated draft cannot be attached by `documents.compose`

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-1: `documents.compose` accepts `card_id` and `meta.generated = true` and creates an attached document with no `draft.apply` check. This is the P0 finding that blocks the fourth clause and the project's closure.

entries.axis_b: A human decision is a person's act on a resolved human approval

value.acceptance: `ladder_human_gate.rs::a_service_principal_cannot_record_a_human_decision` returns `403 person_required`; `::a_human_decision_without_an_approved_human_gate_is_refused` refuses a missing, pending or agent-decided approval; `::a_pending_approval_cannot_gate_a_draft` refuses a pending gate.

entries.axis_b: A human decision cites the approval of its own gate

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-6: `ladder.record` passes `None` for the gate to `human_approved_gate_tx`, so any approved approval with a human approve decision on the same card qualifies. The check must compare `approval.gate` with the decision's gate.

entries.axis_b: Options are authored, versioned rows

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-4: `ladder.evaluate` accepts an inline `options` array and records it with `option_set_version`; there is no authored option-set row the tenant versions independently of the request.

entries.axis_b: Questions are rows with fire_when, min_confidence and fail_policy

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-4: `decision_policy` carries kind, gate, threshold, fail_policy, action and meta; the question is an optional free string on the request, defaulted to the kind, and `fire_when`/`min_confidence` have no columns.

entries.axis_b: Publishing a refinement is a gated policy change

value.acceptance: OPEN — v1-t2-3: `refinements.publish` has `confirm = "none"`, writes the override and bumps the version with no approval; `decision_policies.update` is likewise ungated.

entries.axis_b: L1 asks the laya client and records its answer

value.detail: an approved artefact or contract is immutable and supersession writes the next version; a contract change re-opens its phase gate (SPEC_V2 §8.1; `a_contract_change_reopens_the_gate`).
